meta.title: This city codes for the world

scenes.narration: This city writes code for the entire world.

scenes.title: It started with a dish on a ==bullock cart==
scenes.narration: In 1985, India's first private satellite dish for software arrived in Bangalore, on a bullock cart.

scenes.label: tech workers in one city
scenes.narration: Today, more than a million tech workers live here.

scenes.label: of India's software exports come from Karnataka
scenes.narration: Forty one percent of India's software exports come from this one state, almost all of it from Bengaluru.

scenes.headline: It used to be a **pensioners' paradise.**
scenes.narration: And the plot twist? It used to be called a pensioners' paradise.

scenes.headline: Guess the city? **Bengaluru.**
scenes.narration: Yes, it's Bengaluru. Follow for part two.
